personnes.role.owner_aide: Everything, people, the house's code and integrations included.
personnes.role.member_aide: Controls the whole house and approves automations with the code.
personnes.role.guest_aide: Controls their rooms only, until the chosen date. No cameras, no settings.
personnes.connexion.intro: Sign in to open the house.
personnes.connexion.intro_invitation: Type the code you received, then choose your password.
personnes.connexion.differents: The two passwords are not the same.
personnes.carte.intro: Who lives here, what each one may do, and their phones.
personnes.carte.retirer_confirmer: Remove {name} from the house? Their sessions end at once.
personnes.carte.invitation_aide: Give them this code: in the Moli app or a browser, “I have an invitation code”. Valid until {date}, once.
personnes.carte.invitation_access: The house is behind Cloudflare Access: also add their e-mail to the Access rule (and to their card here), or they will not even see the page.
personnes.carte.emails_aide: If the house is behind Cloudflare Access: the e-mail the person signs in there with. Moli then recognises them without a password.
personnes.carte.mot_de_passe_change: Changed. Sign in again on your other devices.
personnes.carte_page.sous_titre: Where everyone is, from their phone, and the zones automations can use.
personnes.carte_page.aucune_zone: No zone: home appears as soon as a phone has learned it.
personnes.carte_page.touche_la_carte: Touch the map where you want it
personnes.carte_page.retirer_confirmer: Remove the zone {name}? Automations waiting for it will no longer fire.
personnes.carte_page.automatismes: In an automation: “When someone's zone becomes Work”, or “When everyone has left”.
